Messages.Author: Michael J?rgensen
Messages.Body:
Hi!

Two vampires are having af fight over who is the coolest dude in town,
and vamp A(lets say for the sake of argument, Wynn) is being rushed by
vamp B(Wynn´s good old friend, Beast).

Beast hits Wynn for 2(which is not prevented), and Wynn hits beast for
3(which is not prevented).

Now, can Beast play taste of Vitae ? Even though Wynn plays Disarm ?
The Q being, can the acting minion play taste of vitae first even
though they are going to be disarmed ?

Kind Regards

Michael

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:
> "Michael J?rgensen" <mich...@wanadoo.dk> wrote in message news:a88b1ee1.04080...@posting.google.com...

>>The Q being, can the acting minion play taste of vitae first even
>>though they are going to be disarmed ?
>
> Yes.

Just to clarify LSJ's answer: Beast can play Taste _before_ Wynn plays
Disarm (since Beast his acting, that player gets to play cards first).
He cannot play Taste _after_ Wynn plays Disarm (since he will no longer
be ready).

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
mich...@wanadoo.dk (Michael J?rgensen) wrote in message news:<a88b1ee1.04080...@posting.google.com>...
> ...vamp A(lets say for the sake of argument, Wynn) is being rushed by

> vamp B(Wynn´s good old friend, Beast).
>
> Beast hits Wynn for 2(which is not prevented), and Wynn hits beast for
> 3(which is not prevented).
>
> Now, can Beast play taste of Vitae ? Even though Wynn plays Disarm ?
> The Q being, can the acting minion play taste of vitae first even
> though they are going to be disarmed ?

As the acting minion, Beast has the first opportunity to play cards
that are usable at the end of a round of combat, meaning he can play
Taste of Vitae before Wynn Disarms him. In fact, he could play as many
end-of-round effects as he wanted before Wynn could play any (but only
one ToV, by card text).

Messages.Author: crispy
Messages.Body:
mich...@wanadoo.dk (Michael J?rgensen) wrote in message news:<a88b1ee1.04080...@posting.google.com>...



Hi Michael!

Taste of Vitae and Disarm are both played "At the end of a round of
combat" (by card text). The acting minion always has the chance to
play cards first (http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec6_4_1),
so since Beast is acting he could play Taste and get some blood. He
still took more damage than Wynn, though, so Wynn could then play
Disarm. If Wynn was rushing Beast, then Wynn would get to Disarm
first, and since Beast is then on his way to torpor he can't play
Taste of Vitae (by card text).
